class.name: OcgGeomTransformation
class.brief_description: Describes how to construct the following elementary transformations - translations, - rotations, - symmetries, - scales. The Transformation class can also be used to construct complex transformations by combining these elementary transformations. However, these transformations can never change the type of an object. For example, the projection transformation can change a circle into an ellipse, and therefore change the real type of the object. Such a transformation is forbidden in this environment and cannot be a Geom_Transformation. The transformation can be represented as follow :
class.description: ! Describes how to construct the following elementary transformations ! - translations, ! - rotations, ! - symmetries, ! - scales. ! The Transformation class can also be used to ! construct complex transformations by combining these ! elementary transformations. ! However, these transformations can never change ! the type of an object. For example, the projection ! transformation can change a circle into an ellipse, and ! therefore change the real type of the object. Such a ! transformation is forbidden in this environment and ! cannot be a Geom_Transformation. ! The transformation can be represented as follow : ! ! V1 V2 V3 T ! | a11 a12 a13 a14 | | x | | x'| ! | a21 a22 a23 a24 | | y | | y'| ! | a31 a32 a33 a34 | | z | = | z'| ! | 0 0 0 1 | | 1 | | 1 | ! ! where {V1, V2, V3} defines the vectorial part of the ! transformation and T defines the translation part of ! the transformation. ! Note: Geom_Transformation transformations ! provide the same kind of "geometric" services as ! gp_Trsf ones but have more complex data structures. ! The geometric objects provided by the Geom ! package use gp_Trsf transformations in the syntaxes ! Transform and Transformed. ! Geom_Transformation transformations are used in ! a context where they can be shared by several ! objects contained inside a common data structure.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates an identity transformation.

method.name: from_gp_Trsf_const_ref
method.description: Creates a transient copy of T.

method.name: SetMirror_1
method.description: Makes the transformation into a symmetrical transformation with respect to a point P. P is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: SetMirror_2
method.description: Makes the transformation into a symmetrical transformation with respect to an axis A1. A1 is the center of the axial symmetry.

method.name: SetMirror_3
method.description: Makes the transformation into a symmetrical transformation with respect to a plane. The plane of the symmetry is defined with the axis placement A2. It is the plane (Location, XDirection, YDirection).

method.name: SetRotation
method.description: Makes the transformation into a rotation. A1 is the axis rotation and Ang is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: SetScale
method.description: Makes the transformation into a scale. P is the center of the scale and S is the scaling value.

method.name: SetTransformation_2
method.description: Makes a transformation allowing passage from the coordinate system "FromSystem1" to the coordinate system "ToSystem2". Example : In a C++ implementation : Real x1, y1, z1; // are the coordinates of a point in the // local system FromSystem1 Real x2, y2, z2; // are the coordinates of a point in the // local system ToSystem2 gp_Pnt P1 (x1, y1, z1) Geom_Transformation T; T.SetTransformation (FromSystem1, ToSystem2); gp_Pnt P2 = P1.Transformed (T); P2.Coord (x2, y2, z2);

method.name: SetTransformation_1
method.description: Makes the transformation allowing passage from the basic coordinate system {P(0.,0.,0.), VX (1.,0.,0.), VY (0.,1.,0.), VZ (0., 0. ,1.) } to the local coordinate system defined with the Ax2 ToSystem. Same utilisation as the previous method. FromSystem1 is defaulted to the absolute coordinate system.

method.name: SetTranslation_1
method.description: Makes the transformation into a translation. V is the vector of the translation.

method.name: SetTranslation_2
method.description: Makes the transformation into a translation from the point P1 to the point P2.

method.name: SetTrsf
method.description: Converts the gp_Trsf transformation T into this transformation.

method.name: Form
method.description: Returns the nature of this transformation as a value of the gp_TrsfForm enumeration.

method.name: Trsf
method.description: Returns a non transient copy of <me>.

method.name: Invert
method.description: Raised if the transformation is singular. This means that the ScaleFactor is lower or equal to Resolution from package gp.

method.name: Inverted
method.description: Raised if the transformation is singular. This means that the ScaleFactor is lower or equal to Resolution from package gp.

method.name: Multiplied
method.description: Computes the transformation composed with Other and <me>. <me> * Other. Returns a new transformation

method.name: Multiply
method.description: Computes the transformation composed with Other and <me> . <me> = <me> * Other.

method.name: Powered
method.description: Raised if N < 0 and if the transformation is not inversible

method.name: PreMultiply
method.description: Computes the matrix of the transformation composed with <me> and Other. <me> = Other * <me>

method.name: Transforms
method.description: Applies the transformation <me> to the triplet {X, Y, Z}.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Creates a new object which is a copy of this transformation.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
